description: The repo's history digest: hotspots, do-not-retry reverts, suppression ledger, fragile areas, notable events, per-file history. Use when starting work in an unfamiliar repo, before a refactor or large change, or when deciding whether green tests can be trusted.

repo.description: absolute path to the git repository; defaults to the server's working directory, and must be inside it (or a root listed in LOGBOOK_MCP_ROOTS); when that directory is part of a repository (it holds files the repository tracks), the tools work on the repository's root

name: logbook_digest
